sources.text:
# Production token refresh {#policy}

This rule applies only in production: at most one token refresh request may run at a time. This document sets no concurrency rule for other environments.
sources.title: Production token refresh

sources.text:
# Staging token refresh {#policy}

This rule applies only in staging: multiple token refresh requests must run at the same time. This document sets no concurrency rule for other environments.
sources.title: Staging token refresh

sources.text:
# Token refresh concurrency {#policy}

Token refresh requests must be serialized: at most one refresh request may run at a time.
sources.title: Token refresh concurrency

sources.text:
# Token refresh concurrency {#policy}

Token refresh requests follow policy R. The definition of policy R is not included in this document.
sources.title: Token refresh concurrency

sources.text:
# Token refresh audit {#policy}

Every token refresh request must produce an audit log entry after it completes. This requirement does not specify whether refresh requests run sequentially or concurrently.
sources.title: Token refresh audit

sources.text:
# Token refresh concurrency {#policy}

Token refresh requests must run concurrently: multiple refresh requests must run at the same time.
sources.title: Token refresh concurrency
